svg.title: Engine selection for engine = auto
svg.desc: With engine set to auto, ideal circuits run on the statevector (or density matrix when requested); noisy circuits run as an exact density matrix when it fits, and as Monte-Carlo trajectories otherwise or when a time-correlated term is active.
svg.text: time-correlated = leakage or quasi-static detuning; fits = n ≤ QPUTWIN_DENSITY_AUTO_MAX_QUBITS
and 16·4ⁿ B in memory; T = min(shots, QPUTWIN_MAX_TRAJECTORIES)
